result.summary: The receiver refused transfer MSG00403 (ENC-T1, WARD-A to WARD-B) with 409 duplicate_message. Its own records contradict that answer: the receipt lookup returned 404 no_receipt, and the history at version 2, epoch 6, holds only the admit and update entries, without this operation key. There are no later events. The encounter is admitted, so a transfer is allowed. The route supports conditional writes, receipts and dry runs (epoch 6). Resend: one bounded movement, conditional on version 2, taking the record to version 3. If the version has moved, the write fails safely. Shutter can check the result afterwards through the receipt and the history (WIC-5). By inference only (DEP-1.1), the effect contract says a resend frees the WARD-A bed, occupies WARD-B BAY2-04, redirects pharmacy and creates one porter task. Reconcile: not supported, because no receipt shows the transfer committed. Do nothing: per DEP-2.3, the patient stays recorded on WARD-A, the wrong ward, and the downstream harms continue. The OBX-5 free-text note reads like an instruction; it was treated as data and ignored. Catalogue entry E9 prefers resend.

Whether a resend would hit the same duplicate refusal (a dry run should be done first)
Whether the receiver has stored this key with a different payload (RP-2.5); nothing shows it, but it cannot be ruled out from here
